threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still use the tube to get to Shoreditch instead of the bus, and you're baffled why it takes so long during peak hours.
Caught a glimpse of a couple arguing over a half-eaten kebab on the 208. The bus driver just shook his head, classic Bromley chaos.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade outside the Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn station while a couple of DJs set up for a block party. That vibe, you know?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know that feeling when a tram comes to a complete stop just to let a guy finish his phone call? Only in Berlin, folks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their eye-roll when tourists stop to ask if it's always this foggy in summer. We know it’s just our charming microclimates.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenade the Muni crowd with a ukulele while waiting for the 38. Only in San Francisco do you get live music with your delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all Gràcia's squares are just for selfies, missing the locals' quiet morning chats over café amb llet.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they struggle to find the right exit at the Liceu metro. They always look shocked when it spits them out at La Rambla.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You catch yourself waiting for the tube even when it's clear the bus is faster, thinking it's the only way to travel. You’ll learn!
Caught a glimpse of a guy singing to an empty seat on the 35 last night. He looked just like he was serenading a lover. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the U-Bahn car filled with a live DJ and people dancing at 7 AM, that's when I knew Neukölln had its own rhythm.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you enjoy an outdoor cinema in a former factory courtyard, surrounded by graffiti art and the smell of grilled currywurst.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows to avoid 16th Street when BART's down—it's like a ghost town but with some sketchy pop-up food stalls.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in a tuxedo helping a tourist read the Muni map while a pigeon tried to steal his sandwich. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into a local bar and get a table. Meanwhile, the regulars know to stand at the bar and grab a drink quick—it’s the only way.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their tendency to walk into the café and ask for a 'café con leche' in English, oblivious to the locals' amused smiles.
